name: batch-actions
title: BatchActions
description: The bar that appears once rows are selected: the count, what can be done to them, and the way out. It replaces the table's toolbar rather than sitting beside it, so an action can never be ambiguous about what it applies to.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/BatchActions.json
